name: How long does fire damage repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does fire damage repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of fire damage repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage. Minor smoke damage might take a few days to a week for cleaning and deodorization. Extensive structural damage, water damage from firefighting efforts, and widespread smoke and soot can extend the process to several weeks or even months. A professional restoration company will provide a more accurate timeline after a thorough assessment of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity. Minor smoke damage may take days, while extensive structural issues could take weeks or months.
